test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Project PARI is an initiative launched by which of the following organisations/Ministries to celebrate and enhance the public art scene in India?

options.text: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Union Ministry of Culture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Project PARI** (Public Art for Resilient India) is an initiative launched by the **Union Ministry of Culture** to celebrate and enhance the **public art scene in India**.
 
• The project aims to promote **public engagement with art** and provide a platform for **local and contemporary artists** to showcase their creativity in public spaces.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's larger effort to integrate **art and culture into everyday life**, thereby fostering a sense of pride and ownership among citizens.
 
• It emphasizes the **preservation and promotion of India's rich cultural heritage** while also embracing modern and innovative art forms.
 
• Through Project PARI, the Ministry seeks to transform **urban and rural landscapes** by installing public artworks that reflect the diversity and dynamism of Indian culture.
 
• The initiative aligns with the **'Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat' program**, which aims to strengthen cultural unity and collaboration across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lalit Kala Akademi**__

 __
 
• The **Lalit Kala Akademi**, also known as the **National Academy of Art**, is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture.
 
• It was established in **1954** to promote and propagate understanding of **Indian visual arts**, such as painting, sculpture, and graphics.
 
• It organizes **art exhibitions**, workshops, and camps and also provides scholarships and awards to artists.
 
• However, it is not directly involved in public art initiatives like Project PARI.
 
 
 
• **Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)**__
 __
 
• The **CCRT** is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture, established in **1979**.
 
• Its primary objective is to promote the integration of **culture and education** by providing training to school teachers and students in cultural heritage.
 
• It is not directly involved in public art projects but focuses on **educational and cultural enrichment programs**.
 
 
 
• **Sahitya Akademi**__
 
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi**, also known as the National Academy of Letters, is dedicated to the promotion of **literature in India**.
 
• Established in **1954**, it recognizes and awards excellence in **Indian literature** across various languages.
 
• It primarily focuses on **literary works** and activities, not public art or visual arts.
